'''''Silver Bull''''' was a [[container transport]] operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

Shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], it was assigned to rendezvous with [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Aluma]]'' to transfer a VIP scientist at the [[SpecWar Fab]] [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]]. Both [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s forces attacked the rendezvous and were thwarted by an Imperial [[Missile Boat]].
